Headline: #87 87th, #26 South Shore Express, and #30 South Chicago Temporary Reroute near 91st/Brandon
ShortDescription: #87 87th, #26 South Shore Express, and #30 South Chicago buses are temporarily rerouted due to a street blockage near 91st/Brandon.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#87 87th, #26 South Shore Express, and #30 South Chicago buses are temporarily rerouted due to a street blockage near 91st/Brandon.

Eastbound #87 87th and 26th South Shore Express buses are temporarily rerouted via 91st, Brandon, 92nd, Houston, 91st, and over the regular route due to street blockage near 91st/Brandon.

Westbound buses are not affected.

#30 South Shore Express

Southbound: 92nd, Burley, 91st and over the regular route. 

Northbound: 91st, Branden, 92nd  and over the regular route. 

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: 95th-bound Red Line trains bypassing Wilson
ShortDescription: UPDATE: 95th-bound Red Line trains are running, but not stopping at Wilson due to police activity.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
95th-bound Red Line trains are running, but not stopping at Wilson due to police activity.

As a result, where riders needing station Wilson, can transfer to 95th-bound service and ride back to bypassed stop at Sheridan. 

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

#70  Montrose

#81 Lawrence

See station personnel for further assistance, and pay attention to announcements on trains and at stations for service information.

We are working to restore service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.
